question: In which type of ancestral rite is the hand-smearing procedure not applicable?
premises: Pleasing may be done by smearing with the hand.
The verse states a restriction on this rule.
The restriction applies to single-aimed rites.
inference: This rule of pleasing by hand-smearing does not apply in single-aimed rites.
plain_english: One may please by smearing with the hand, but this rule does not apply in rites aimed at a single ancestor.
